question:
Find the circumference (in m) of the largest circle that can be drawn completely inside a rectangle whose dimensions are given as 14 m and 116 m.

( Take pi=(22)/(7). )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The diameter of the largest circle inscribed in a rectangle equals its shorter side (breadth).

Diameter (d) = 14 m

Circumference = π × d

Circumference = (22 ÷ 7) × 14 = 44 m

**∴ The correct answer is 44 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 Length = 116 m
 Breadth = 14 m
 d = 14 m

**Given:**

Length of the rectangle (l) = 116 m

Breadth of the rectangle (b) = 14 m

**Concept Used:**

The largest circle that can be drawn completely inside a rectangle is limited by the shorter side of the rectangle. Hence, the diameter of the circle will be exactly equal to the breadth of the rectangle.

Diameter (d) = 14 m

Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 m

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of a circle = 2 × π × r

**Calculation:**

⇒ Circumference = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 7

⇒ Circumference = 2 × 22

⇒ Circumference = 44 m

**∴ The correct answer is 44 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Inscribed Circle

The area of the largest circle inscribed in a rectangle of dimensions l × b (where b is the shorter side) is given by the formula π × (b ÷ 2)².

Circumcircle of a Rectangle

A circle drawn passing through all four vertices of a rectangle is called its circumcircle. The diameter of this circumcircle is exactly equal to the diagonal of the rectangle: d = √(l² + b²).

Largest Square in a Circle

The diagonal of the largest square that can be inscribed in a given circle is equal to the diameter of the circle. The side of this square is d ÷ √2.
